exposure: Mode of delivery (vaginal vs. cesarean with labor vs. cesarean without labor)
cohort: 324 mothers who delivered full-term (≥ 37 weeks) singleton infants
finding: Antimicrobial peptides (AMPs), particularly peptidase inhibitor 3 (PI3), were upregulated in vaginal delivery compared to cesarean section with or without labor.
mod_finding: Antimicrobial peptides (AMPs), particularly peptidase inhibitor 3 (PI3), were upregulated in vaginal delivery compared to cesarean section with or without labor.
